purpose: Determine whether the spent-data gas-minus-star flux preference in P0646 has an identifiable interior universal strength or simply runs to a boundary.

cross_validation.fold_definition: reuse exact P0645 five source-family-stratified folds
cross_validation.selection_metric: pooled exact CV RMS among rows with complete roots

claim_boundary: All image-position scores are from spent RX J2129 data and cannot validate the closure.
Only lambda changes; the activation, component fractions, smoothing, folds, and conventional six-parameter geometry model remain fixed.
The spent P0601 heldout split is descriptive and is not used to select lambda.
An endpoint optimum, a missing selected root, or the absence of a strict root-complete local minimum rejects this strength family.
Even a passing interior optimum must survive map robustness, a generic multipole control, and unchanged multi-cluster transfer before P0640 is opened.
